Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "there should definitely be batching at inference time"; the job is to "systemize and generalize" the ad hoc eval-speed work in Manabot so it is "as easy and simple as possible to get performance, cost, and reliability at or above what we've been doing"; and for easily changed numbers "Just use something reasonable". So: eval jobs sharing a server must be able to play at the same time so their requests batch together (in-turn play is not enough); pick reasonable values for tunable numbers without raising them. A study of Manabot's prior eval optimisation is under way in the EXP-66 conversation and its design conclusions will follow as a steer; do not wait idle, but expect them.
